description: A script for stress testing devtool commands ('extract' and 'modify') within the OpenEmbedded build environment, involving recipe selection, execution, and logging.

methods.name: select_recipes
methods.description: Selects recipes based on command-line arguments, filtering by skip classes, resume point, and pattern matching.

methods.name: stress_extract
methods.description: Performs extraction testing on selected recipes, logging failures and handling signals.

methods.name: stress_modify
methods.description: Performs modification and build testing on selected recipes, including cleanup and error handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, sets up environment, and dispatches to subcommands.
